title: Industrial Transformation Saudi Arabia
description:
Industrial Transformation Saudi Arabia, taking place 29 Nov – 1 Dec 2027 at Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center (RICEC), is a dedicated industry platform held under the patronage of the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources and powered by Hannover Messe’s global industrial network. The event brings automation, robotics, digitalization, energy solutions, industrial 5G, intralogistics, and additive manufacturing under one roof, enabling visitors to compare technologies through live demos and real use-cases, meet operations and procurement leaders, and explore practical insights across multiple content stages, including Innovation Summit sessions—making it a key destination for factories, EPCs, and system integrators accelerating industrial transformation in the Kingdom.

Register Now

title: Global Health Exhibition
description:
Global Health Exhibition 2026 takes place in Riyadh on 25–28 October 2027 at the Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Center (Malham) under the theme “Invest in Health,” bringing together global healthcare leaders, decision-makers, investors, and innovators to shape the next era of health. The event spotlights the trends and partnerships accelerating digital transformation and new models of care—from AI in clinical practice and digital health to workforce evolution and breakthrough medical technologies—through a major exhibition and multi-stage conference programme. Key stages include the Leaders Summit, Medical Excellence Forum, Digital Health Forum, and Investor x Venture Forum, offering attendees real-world insights, networking, and opportunities to explore a more integrated, tech-driven healthcare ecosystem.

Register Now

title: Venture Capital World Summit
description:
The Venture Capital World Summit – Riyadh World Series Season will take place on 21 October 2027 in Riyadh. The summit will bring together venture capital investors, startup founders, entrepreneurs, family offices, business leaders, and international delegates, connecting Saudi Arabia’s growing innovation ecosystem with global investment opportunities. Discussions will span sectors including technology, financial services, artificial intelligence, sustainability, healthcare, tourism, and logistics, in line with the Kingdom’s economic transformation under Saudi Vision 2030.

Buy Tickets
address: Building 3.09, King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD), Riyadh

title: Global AI Summit (GAIN)
description:
Under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, the Global AI Summit takes place at King Abdulaziz International Convention Centre in Riyadh, bringing together global leaders, innovators, and decision-makers to explore how generative AI can move from ambitious theory to real-world outcomes. Through keynotes, discussions, showcases, and immersive experiences, the summit focuses on the big questions shaping AI’s future—responsible development, practical adoption, and collaboration—highlighting breakthroughs that can accelerate progress, strengthen resilience, and create measurable benefits for people and communities worldwide. 

Live Stream of GAIN
address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh

title: Beautyworld Saudi Arabia
description:
Beautyworld Riyadh 2027 brings together leading beauty brands, professionals, and industry experts from around the world to showcase the latest products, innovations, and trends across the beauty and personal care sector, supporting the continued growth of Saudi Arabia’s beauty industry.

Register Now

title: Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo
description:
Taking place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Convention Center, Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo is the Kingdom’s first dedicated trade event for museums, heritage, and cultural development. The three-day exhibition brings together more than 100 exhibiting companies and over 3,000 visitors, including museums, galleries, science centers, cultural institutions, government entities, private collectors, and heritage developers.

Co-located with the Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo (SEA Expo) and the Saudi Light and Sound Expo (SLS Expo), Merath provides a strategic platform to connect with decision-makers and explore opportunities within Saudi Arabia’s rapidly expanding $67 billion heritage and museum market, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a growing hub for cultural innovation and investment.

title: Saudi Light and Sound (SLS) Expo
description:
Discover the future of Saudi Arabia’s professional light and sound industry at the Saudi Light & Sound (SLS) Exhibition, the premier platform for event technology, lighting design, and audio innovations. The exhibition offers a rare opportunity to present AV and lighting solutions at the heart of a fast-evolving market, with the Pro AV segment valued at $30.5 million in 2024 and projected to reach $40.5 million by 2033, fueled by smart city investments and immersive event infrastructure. Visitors can connect with decision-makers driving billion-dollar projects, explore cutting-edge solutions across pro lighting, audio equipment, stage technology, digital signage, laser effects, and theatrical systems, and position their brand at the forefront of the region’s pro light and sound transformation.

Register Now

title: Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo
description:
The Saudi Entertainment and Amusement (SEA) Expo, running for over 8 years in Riyadh, is the Kingdom’s premier platform for the global entertainment and attractions industry. Bringing together innovators, suppliers, and decision-makers from across the Middle East and Africa, the expo showcases the latest technologies and solutions shaping the future of leisure and attractions. More than just an exhibition, SEA Expo offers opportunities to connect with like-minded industry experts, foster collaboration, and take businesses to new heights in Saudi Arabia’s rapidly growing entertainment sector.

Register Now

title: E3 Customer Experience Conference
description:
The E3 Customer Experience Conference (6th Edition) takes place in Riyadh, bringing together leaders and practitioners to shape the next generation of customer experience in Saudi Arabia’s fast-growing market. Supported by Tajriba and the National CX Academy Saudi Arabia, the event spotlights how AI, digital transformation, and analytics are redefining customer interactions in line with Vision 2030, with sessions covering customer journey mapping, omnichannel strategies, personalisation, brand experience, and emerging technologies. The programme features a multi-format experience including a conference, C-level CX masterclass, workshops, a CX Startup Zone, an exhibition, and the CX Hackathon, offering practical insights and connections to help organizations strengthen loyalty and satisfaction.

Register Now

title: Riyadh Racing Season
description:
Riyadh Racing Season takes place at King Abdulaziz Racecourse in Riyadh from 16 October 2026 to 17 April 2027, featuring a full calendar of exciting race meetings and major cups throughout the season. A key highlight is Saudi Cup Weekend on 5 & 6 February 2027, featuring the world’s richest race, The Saudi Cup, worth US$20 million. Race meeting details will appear here shortly before the season begins.

The season will run for six months, spanning 24 weeks and featuring 50 race meetings held every Friday and Saturday. It will include 569 races and 52 major racing cups, with the season scheduled to conclude on April 17, 2027.

The racing program comprises 465 races for Thoroughbreds and 104 for purebred Arabian horses, along with 35 races on the turf track, reflecting the diversity of competitions and their competitive standards.

The season will also feature the Saudi Cup, the world's richest horse race, as part of a race meeting offering more than $38 million in prize money. The event attracts leading horses, jockeys, and trainers from around the world, further strengthening Saudi Arabia's position on the international horse racing stage.

Beyond the sporting competitions, King Abdulaziz Racecourse will offer a range of entertainment, cultural, and community activities for visitors of all ages. These activities aim to enrich the visitor experience and reinforce the racecourse's position as an integrated sports and entertainment destination during weekends.

 Buy Tickets

title: Human Capability Initiative Conference
description:
Under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince, Prime Minister, and Chairman of the Human Capability Development Program (HCDP) Committee, the third edition of the Human Capability Initiative (HCI) Conference—one of the Saudi Vision 2030 Realization Programs—will take place on April 12–13, 2027, at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh under the theme “The Human Code.”

The conference will focus on three pillars: deep human connection, sound reasoning amid complexity, and value-driven creation to safeguard human contribution and purpose in the age of accelerated technological advancement. HCI 2027 aims to attract more than 15,000 visitors and over 250 local and international speakers, including policymakers, thought leaders, and experts from government, private, nonprofit, and global institutions, providing a platform to exchange best practices and showcase inspiring global success stories.

The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland will participate as Country of Honor, reflecting the strength of the Saudi-British strategic partnership in advancing human capability development. Building on the success of previous editions—which welcomed over 23,000 visitors, featured 550+ speakers, and announced more than 156 launches and agreements—the conference reinforces the Kingdom’s commitment to investing in human potential as a foundation for sustainable growth and global competitiveness in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh

title: Riyadh International Humanitarian Forum
description:
Under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) will host the fifth edition of the Riyadh International Humanitarian Forum on April 11–12, 2027, in Riyadh.

Organized in partnership with the United Nations and its humanitarian agencies, the forum will bring together leaders of international and regional organizations, donors, humanitarian practitioners, policymakers, and experts to discuss global humanitarian challenges, strengthen collaboration, and explore innovative approaches to relief and humanitarian action.

The forum aims to foster strategic partnerships, promote knowledge exchange, and support sustainable humanitarian solutions that improve access to assistance for people in need worldwide.

title: Exhibition: Along the Way
description:
Along the Way exhibition brings together 34 artists, tracing shared journeys where memory, movement, and experience intersect across generations. Featuring diverse artistic practices, archival materials, and rare manuscripts, the exhibition explores movement as a path to reflection, discovery, and understanding.

Know More
address: Prince Faisal Bin Fahd Arts Hall, Riyadh

description:
AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™ brings together 24 of Asia’s top national teams for the 19th edition of the continent’s premier football tournament. Taking place from 7 January to 5 February 2027, the competition features 51 matches across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Al Khobar, progressing from the group stage to the final.

title: 24th ERRA Annual Conference
description:
The 24th ERRA Annual Conference takes place in Riyadh from February 1 to 3, bringing together international regulators, experts, and industry leaders to discuss the future of electricity sector governance and transformation. Hosted by the Saudi Electricity Regulatory Authority (SERA), the conference is held under the theme “From Oversight to Foresight: The Proactive Regulator in the Electricity Transformation.”

The conference explores forward-looking regulatory approaches, innovation in electricity markets, consumer protection, and evolving energy systems. It also reflects Riyadh’s growing role as a destination for major international forums and supports the Kingdom’s wider ambitions in energy leadership and sustainable development.

Registration

title: Saudi Media Forum and the Future of Media Exhibition (FOMEX)
description:
The Saudi Media Forum 2027 takes place in Riyadh from 1 to 3 February 2027, under the patronage of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud. The sixth edition brings together media leaders, experts, and industry professionals for discussions and workshops on digital transformation, innovation, and the future of media.

The forum features the Future of Media Exhibition (FOMEX), with more than 250 local and international companies and media channels showcasing media technologies and production solutions. Other highlights include the third Media Innovation Camp, focusing on emerging technologies and artificial intelligence, and the Production Market, connecting content creators, producers, buyers, and media platforms to explore investment, distribution, and co-production opportunities.

Register Now

title: Future Minerals Forum
description:
The sixth Future Minerals Forum (FMF) will take place in Riyadh from 12–14 January 2027, under the theme “Global Collaboration for Resilient Mineral Supply.” Organized by the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources, the global forum will bring together government representatives, industry leaders, investors, financial institutions, and experts to advance collaboration across the minerals sector. Discussions will focus on mobilizing investment, accelerating mining projects, strengthening mineral supply chains, and developing resilient mineral value chains in Saudi Arabia and emerging supplier regions.

The program will include a Ministerial Roundtable, investment and funding activities, market and commodity outlook sessions, leadership roundtables, and knowledge-exchange meetings, connecting mineral opportunities and projects with international capital, technology, and expertise.

Register Now
address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh

title: World Stadiums and Arenas Summit
description:
The World Stadiums and Arenas Summit brings together global sports infrastructure leaders, architects, developers, government stakeholders, and sports federations to explore the latest developments in stadium design, smart technologies, sustainability, and sports facilities development, supporting Saudi Arabia’s growing sports and entertainment sector.

Register Now

title: World Stadiums, Arenas Summit, Athlete 360
description:
The World Stadiums and Arenas Summit—the region’s largest stadiums and sports facilities conference and exhibition—returns to Riyadh at Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences. This flagship gathering brings together global leaders, architects, developers, government stakeholders, and sports federations to showcase cutting-edge technologies, sustainable design solutions, and best practices in building and upgrading stadiums and sports venues. With Saudi Vision 2030 driving major investment in sports and entertainment infrastructure, the summit offers a front-row view of the latest industry trends—from smart stadiums to eco-friendly facilities—and how they are shaping the future of sport in the Kingdom and beyond.

Know More

World Sports 360 Summit and Athlete 360

Co-located with the World Stadiums and Arenas Summit, World Sports 360 Summit, Athlete 360, brings together global experts, elite athletes, coaches, and industry leaders to shape the future of sports, wellness, and human performance in the Kingdom. Focused on integrating performance and health, the programme spotlights cutting-edge performance optimisation (recovery, data-driven training, and advanced technology), holistic athlete development (nutrition, sports medicine, mental resilience, and long-term wellbeing), and the evolving Saudi sports landscape powered by Vision 2030. Expect practical insights, knowledge exchange, and forward-looking discussions spanning the sports economy, club management, revenue strategies, talent development and scouting, and the latest innovations in athlete technology and performance.

Know More

The programme also features the World Stadiums and Arenas Awards, celebrating standout achievements in stadium and arena development across 10 categories highlighting innovation, sustainability, and exceptional project delivery—including architectural design for new venues, renovation and modernisation, innovative materials, multi-use design, creative lighting, eco-friendly architecture, community and social impact, safety and security leadership, accessibility and inclusivity initiatives, and the People’s Choice Award for outstanding stadium design.

title: Six Kings Slam
description:
Six Kings Slam returns to Riyadh as part of Riyadh Season 2026, with the tournament rescheduled from October to 27–30 December 2026. The event will bring together six of the world's top men's tennis players in an exciting single-elimination exhibition tournament. Fans can look forward to world-class matches featuring Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Alexander Zverev, Taylor Fritz, and Alex de Minaur, alongside rising American star Learner Tien.

Book Now

title: Immersive Experience: Flying Over Saudi
description:
“Flying Over Saudi” at Boulevard City, Riyadh offers a one-of-a-kind tourism and entertainment experience—the first of its kind in the Kingdom—inviting visitors into a fully immersive theater that engages all five senses through stunning visuals, surround sound, realistic motion, touch, and scent. Enjoy a 7-minute aerial tour that feels like flying, taking you across Saudi Arabia’s most breathtaking natural landscapes and iconic landmarks in an unforgettable, awe-inspiring journey through the Kingdom’s highlights.

Book Tickets

title: Next-Gen IoT Expo
description:
The Next Gen IoT Expo will take place at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center (RICEC), positioning Riyadh as a gateway to the future of technology. As the evolution of the prestigious IoT event in its fourth edition, the expo showcases cutting-edge next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) solutions integrated with Artificial Intelligence (AI), highlighting their impact across sectors such as healthcare, smart cities, logistics, manufacturing, banking, and more. Bringing together global tech leaders, policymakers, innovators, and international technology companies, the event serves as a dynamic platform for collaboration, knowledge exchange, and growth, featuring 100+ exhibitors, 50 conference speakers, 25 workshop sessions, and thousands of visitors, all focused on shaping smarter, more connected digital ecosystems.

Register Now

title: Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games
description:
Riyadh is hosting the 6th Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games, welcoming athletes from 45 Asian countries in one of the continent’s most prestigious multi-sport events.

title: Riyadh International Book Fair
description:
The Riyadh International Book Fair 2026 brings together publishers, authors, translators, intellectuals, and readers from Saudi Arabia and around the world. The fair showcases the latest literary and intellectual publications and features panel discussions, workshops, and lectures that promote reading, literature, publishing, and translation.

Know More

title: Saudi Makes Future AI Expo
description:
From 14 to 16 December 2026, Riyadh will host Saudi Makes Future, the Kingdom’s premier innovation, culture, and education expo, inspired by the global We Make Future, the International Trade Fair on AI, Tech and Digital Innovation. Organized by PNG KSA in partnership with Search On Media Group, this landmark event will bring together entrepreneurs, innovators, educators, policymakers, and cultural leaders from across the world to explore the future of artificial intelligence, digital innovation, sustainability, and creative industries. With a rich program of talks, panels, startup competitions, and exhibitions, the event will serve as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and investment, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 and reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a regional and global hub for technology and the knowledge economy.

Register Now

title: CPHI Middle East
description:
CPHI Middle East returns in 2026 as the region’s most comprehensive pharmaceutical gathering, building on the success of its 2024 edition that welcomed over 30,000 visitors from more than 100 countries. With Saudi Arabia’s pharmaceutical market projected to reach USD 15 billion by 2028, the event positions itself at the forefront of Middle East and Africa’s growth, creating unmatched opportunities for global suppliers, regional drug manufacturers, and industry leaders to forge partnerships, exchange expertise, and drive innovation across the entire pharma value chain.

Register Now
address: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre, Malham

title: BIO Middle East (BIOME)
description:
Taking place alongside CPHI Middle East 2026, BIO Middle East serves as a specialized biotechnology platform that complements the region’s largest pharmaceutical gathering. While CPHI brings together the full pharmaceutical value chain, BIO Middle East focuses on advanced biotechnology, strategic partnerships, and life sciences innovation.

As the region’s pioneering platform for strategic networking and high-impact public-private collaboration, the event connects global and regional leaders through the partneringONE platform, enabling curated meetings that foster partnerships, licensing opportunities, and investment deals. Co-located with CPHI Middle East, BIO Middle East features a focused agenda covering cell and gene therapies, mRNA technologies, next-generation vaccines, and biomanufacturing — offering a unique blend of scientific insight and commercial opportunity that drives biotech growth across Saudi Arabia and the wider region.

Register Now

Together, the two events create a comprehensive industry ecosystem — uniting pharma manufacturing, biotech innovation, investment, and research — and reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s growing role as a regional and global hub for healthcare and life sciences.
address: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre, Malham

title: International Engineering Conference (IECE)
description:
Riyadh will host the fourth edition of the International Engineering Conference and Exhibition (IECE 2026) from 14–16 December 2026 at ROSHN Front. Organized by the Saudi Council of Engineers under the patronage of the Minister of Municipalities and Housing, the event will bring together engineering leaders, experts, and specialists to discuss the latest developments in engineering, artificial intelligence, innovation, and sustainable solutions through conferences, workshops, and an accompanying exhibition.

Register Now
address: Riyadh Front Exhibitions and Convention Centre

title: Future Projects Forum
description:
The 8th Global Future Projects Forum and Exhibition 2026, organized by the Saudi Contractors Authority, will take place in Riyadh from December 7 to 10 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center. The event brings together contractors, stakeholders, and project owners from both the public and private sectors, offering a global platform to explore upcoming projects, understand application procedures, and engage with key industry leaders.

Featuring a comprehensive program that includes the main forum, an international exhibition, contracting excellence awards, a finance conference, and the annual meeting of the Confederation of International Contractors Association, the forum is expected to host over 400 local and international entities. It aims to enhance transparency, foster partnerships, support sector growth, and promote knowledge exchange in line with Saudi Vision 2030, while creating valuable networking opportunities across the construction and projects ecosystem.

Register Now

title: Saudi International Rehab Expo
description:
Saudi International Rehab Expo 2026 brings together rehabilitation specialists, care providers, technology innovators, public institutions, education leaders, and decision-makers to explore the latest developments in disability support, rehabilitation technologies, and services. The exhibition provides a platform for showcasing solutions, exchanging expertise, and building connections that contribute to enhancing rehabilitation services and quality of life.

Register Now
address: The Arena Riyadh Venue for Exhibitions

title: Information Security Event: Black Hat
description:
Black Hat Middle East & Africa returns to Riyadh from December 1–3, 2026, for its fifth edition. The conference brings together 40,000+ attendees, 500+ global brands, 330+ CISOs, and over 300 expert speakers for three intensive days of innovation, networking, and knowledge-sharing. As a global hub for information security, the event will feature groundbreaking research on vulnerabilities, AI-driven protection, and emerging cyber threats, connecting professionals and decision-makers from across the world.

Register Now

title: Global Airports Forum
description:
The Global Airports Forum 2026 (GAF) brings together aviation leaders, government authorities, airport operators, investors, and technology providers to explore the latest solutions shaping smarter, safer, and more sustainable airports. The forum features industry insights, new technologies, networking, and business opportunities supporting the future of aviation.

Register Now

title: Global Logistics Forum | UNCTAD Global Supply Chain Forum
description:
Under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, Riyadh will host the Global Logistics Forum (GLF) alongside UNCTAD Global Supply Chain Forum (GSCF) from November 29 to December 1, 2026. The two forums bring together global leaders, policymakers, and industry experts to shape the future of logistics and supply chains, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leading global logistics hub connecting three continents.

Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy, the forums provide an international platform to strengthen partnerships, enhance sector competitiveness, foster innovation, and promote resilient, efficient, and sustainable global supply chains in the face of evolving geopolitical, economic, environmental, and technological challenges.
address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center, Riyadh

title: King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival
description:
King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival returns from November 17 to 30, bringing together falconers from Saudi Arabia and around the world. Organized by the National Center for Falcons, the festival stands as one of the Kingdom’s leading heritage events, celebrating the deep-rooted tradition of falconry in the Arabian Peninsula. With prize money exceeding SAR 38 million, the event highlights the Kingdom’s commitment to preserving national heritage, raising public awareness of falconry traditions, and reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a global hub for falconry in line with Vision 2030.

Know More
address: King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival, Malham - Riyadh

title: National Center for Falcons Auction
description:
National Center for Falcons Auction 2026 runs from October 1 to November 30, coinciding with the annual migration and capture season. Organized by the National Center for Falcons, the auction is one of the Kingdom’s leading falconry events, dedicated to locally captured falcons and supporting Saudi Arabia’s position as a global hub for falconry heritage.

Highly anticipated by falconers each year, the auction provides a professional platform that streamlines the buying and selling process while showcasing falcons through competitive live bidding sessions. The event is broadcast on television channels and streamed social media platforms, allowing wider participation from enthusiasts across the Kingdom and beyond. The auction also reflects a commitment to wildlife conservation by prohibiting the sale of endangered species and raising awareness of falcon protection, with particular focus on the saker falcon.

Know More
address: National Center for Falcons in Malham - Riyadh

title: Conference: XP Music Futures
description:
XP Music Futures returns for its 6th edition, marking six years of building communities, shaping ideas, and driving the future of music in the region. The event features inspiring talks, transformative workshops, and groundbreaking musical discoveries, creating a vibrant platform that empowers talent and accelerates the growth of the regional music industry.

Know More

title: Solar & Storage Live
description:
Solar & Storage Live—Saudi Arabia’s largest renewable energy exhibition—takes place in Riyadh on 23–25 November at Riyadh Front, bringing together the people and technologies driving the Kingdom’s transition to a greener, smarter, and more energy-efficient future. Focused on the full lifecycle of residential, commercial & industrial, and utility-scale solar and storage projects—from design and construction to operation—the event connects utilities, independent power producers, financiers, government and regulators, large energy users, and energy start-ups to explore innovative solutions, discover the latest products and services, and build partnerships that help future-proof the region’s energy sector.

Register Now

title: Cityscape Global
description:
Cityscape Global returns to Riyadh on 16–19 November 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Centre (Malham), bringing together developers, investors, policymakers, and industry leaders to explore the future of urban living and the next chapter of real estate growth in Saudi Arabia and beyond. Aligned with Vision 2030, the event serves as a major platform for investment and opportunity—showcasing landmark developments and giga projects while highlighting the Kingdom’s rapidly evolving market, especially as property ownership expands to non-Saudis, making this a key moment to connect, discover new prospects, and engage with one of the world’s fastest-growing real estate destinations.

Register Now
address: Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center - Malham - Riyadh

title: Saudi Elenex
description:
Saudi Elenex 2026 (27th Edition) returns to Riyadh on 16–19 November 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, continuing more than 27 years as a leading meeting point for the sectors of electricity, alternative energy, air conditioning, lighting, and water technology. The exhibition offers structured opportunities to connect with key decision-makers and buyers—bringing together distributors, trade buyers, project owners, consultants, architectural engineers, and specifiers—to discover, compare, and source innovative products, solutions, and services from industry professionals, suppliers, and solution providers across the region.

Register Now

title: Intersec Saudi Arabia
description:
Intersec Saudi Arabia is the leading and largest trade fair for security, safety, and fire protection—returns in October 2026, bringing together high-profile buyers, decision-makers, and industry leaders seeking the latest technologies and solutions. The event is a prime platform to discover innovations across security systems, safety solutions, and fire protection, connect with suppliers and experts, and explore new partnerships that support safer, more resilient environments across the Kingdom.

Register Now

title: 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026
description:
The 6th United Nations World Data Forum (UNWDF 2026) is taking place in Riyadh, bringing together representatives from governments, international organizations, academia, civil society, national statistical offices, and the private sector to discuss the future of data and its role in supporting policymaking and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Established by the United Nations in 2017, the UN World Data Forum is a high-level international platform dedicated to advancing data and statistics in response to global developments. It highlights the importance of statistical indicators in informing decision-making, shaping public policies, and supporting economic and sustainable development planning.

Saudi Arabia's hosting of the sixth edition reflects the Kingdom's commitment to advancing international cooperation, strengthening strategic partnerships in data and statistics, and supporting the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. The forum will provide an international platform for knowledge exchange, sharing best practices, fostering innovation in data, and strengthening collaboration among stakeholders from around the world.

Register Now

Initiative: Road to Riyadh (R2R)
As part of the preparations for the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026, the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) launched the "Road to Riyadh" program to promote awareness of the Kingdom's role in data and statistics and support knowledge exchange and international collaboration.

The initiative featured a series of in-person and virtual sessions, seminars, and workshops held across several cities in the Kingdom throughout the year.

The program reflects GASTAT's ongoing efforts to strengthen the Kingdom's position in the statistical field and support the development of data and statistical systems in line with the Sustainable Development Goals and Saudi Vision 2030.

title: Build Your House exhibition
description:
Build Your House Saudi 2026 brings together professionals, suppliers, developers, and homeowners within a dedicated platform focused on the Kingdom’s growing residential construction and housing sector.

The exhibition showcases building materials, construction solutions, interior design services, home technologies, and renovation products, while creating opportunities for networking, collaboration, and market expansion across Saudi Arabia’s rapidly evolving real estate and construction landscape.

Know More

title: DGA Innovation Challenge – Pitches and Evaluation
description:
The Pitches and Evaluation stage of the Innovation Challenge Accelerator (GovJam) 2026 will take place from 10–12 November 2026 in Riyadh. Launched by the Digital Government Authority (DGA) in partnership with the Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority (Monsha’at), STV, Microsoft Saudi Arabia, NVIDIA, TASAMA, Amjad Watan, and GIE, the accelerator aims to strengthen government-private sector collaboration and enable startups and entrepreneurs to develop innovative and sustainable digital solutions.

During this stage, participating startups and small businesses will present their innovative solutions and products to government entities and investment funds, creating opportunities for evaluation, collaboration, and potential partnerships.

Register Now
address: Digital Government Authority - Innovation Center, Riyadh

title: Pet & Vet Expo
description:
Saudi Arabia’s pet industry has experienced remarkable growth in recent years, driven by a rising number of pet owners and increasing demand for high-quality products and services tailored to animal care. As household incomes grow and the middle class expands, pet owners are becoming more discerning in their choice of premium food, accessories, and veterinary services.

Now in its fourth consecutive year, Saudi Pet Expo reflects the strength and potential of this rapidly developing market. The Kingdom’s pet care market is valued at approximately SAR 5.1 billion, with an annual growth rate exceeding 9%. Saudi Arabia also imports pet and bird food from 18 countries worldwide, highlighting the sector’s global integration and expanding opportunities for industry stakeholders.

Register Now

title: Saudi Drone Exhibition SADEX
description:
Saudi Drone Exhibition SADEX 2026 takes place in Riyadh on 9–11 November 2026, bringing together the full drone and Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) ecosystem—manufacturers, regulators, investors, operators, and end users—under one roof to power the next generation of unmanned aviation. Across a three-day exhibition and conference, the event showcases cutting-edge advances in smart aerial mobility, autonomous logistics, AI integration, and communications, while offering tailored matchmaking that connects exhibitors with decision-makers, government buyers, mega-project leaders, and industry executives to unlock partnerships and new business opportunities. With international participation from 20+ countries, SADEX is positioned as a key platform for collaboration, investment, and technology exchange accelerating UAS adoption across Saudi Arabia’s growth sectors.

Register Now

MAVEX 2026 (Marine Autonomous Vehicles Exhibition)
Running alongside SADEX 2026, MAVEX 2026 is Saudi Arabia’s landmark exhibition dedicated to unmanned maritime systems—including USVs, UUVs, and ROVs—showcasing the latest in autonomous maritime and naval technologies. Leveraging the Kingdom’s strategic coastal geography, MAVEX highlights innovation across ports operations, naval protection, offshore oil, marine ecology, intelligent logistics, leisure navigation, and aquaculture, positioning Riyadh as a meeting point for maritime autonomy and next-generation ocean solutions.

SAUDI UGV 2026 (Unmanned Ground Vehicles Exhibition)
Also co-located with SADEX 2026, SAUDI UGV 2026 debuts as the Kingdom’s dedicated platform for Unmanned Ground Vehicles, spotlighting breakthroughs in robotics, artificial intelligence, and autonomous mobility. Designed to drive innovation and cross-sector collaboration, the exhibition focuses on real-world operational needs across homeland security, energy, logistics, and industrial applications, connecting solution providers with stakeholders shaping the future of ground autonomy in Saudi Arabia.

title: Cat Show
description:
The International Cat Show 2026 returns to Saudi Arabia for its third edition, taking place at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, as part of the Saudi Pet & Vet Expo.

Organized by the World Cat Federation (WCF) in collaboration with Cattus Invictus Kedvencek Magyar Egyesülete (KET), the event brings together breeders, cat enthusiasts, and international judges for a professional competition atmosphere. Participants will be evaluated according to WCF-certified standards, including breed, color, and age, with judging criteria covering body structure, head, ears, eyes, and coat. Visitors can look forward to discovering exceptional feline breeds and witnessing the crowning of the event’s King and Queen of Cats in one of the Kingdom’s most distinguished pet events.

title: International Trenchless Tunnelling Conference
description:
The 3rd International Trenchless Tunnelling Conference brings together industry leaders, experts, and decision-makers to explore trenchless and underground construction technologies supporting Saudi Arabia’s growing infrastructure and urban development. Held at Fairmont Riyadh, the event highlights solutions that enable major infrastructure projects while minimizing disruption, protecting existing assets, and accelerating project delivery.

title: Seamless Saudi Arabia
description:
Seamless Saudi Arabia is the Kingdom’s most comprehensive event for digital commerce, next-generation payments, and embedded finance, bringing together the full value chain—from digital marketing and e-commerce platforms to in-store retail technology, omnichannel customer experiences, and innovative payment solutions. It’s where merchants, SMEs, retailers, banks, payment providers, logistics leaders, and policymakers meet to explore how every customer touchpoint—from the first ad click to checkout and doorstep delivery—is being reimagined, and to connect with partners and technologies shaping seamless checkout journeys, embedded finance tools, digital loyalty programmes, and the wider payments ecosystem supporting Saudi Arabia’s digital economy.

title: Saudi Statistics Forum
description:
The Second Saudi Statistics Forum is a high-level national platform organized by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) to strengthen cooperation, promote statistical integration, support capacity development, and facilitate knowledge exchange across the Kingdom's statistical ecosystem.

Building on the success of its inaugural edition held in April 2025, the second edition will be held under the theme "Towards an Integrated Statistical Ecosystem" on 9 November 2026 in Riyadh, alongside the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026.

The Forum is expected to bring together Their Highnesses, Excellencies, ministers, representatives of international organizations and statistical offices, local and international experts, decision-makers, and academics. It will feature specialized sessions and an accompanying exhibition with broad participation from local and international organizations.

The Forum aims to raise awareness of the role of official statistics in policymaking and national development, strengthen partnerships between national and international statistical entities, and promote knowledge sharing to support a more integrated and sustainable statistical ecosystem.

Register Now

Initiative: Road to Riyadh (R2R)
As part of the preparations for the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026, the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) launched the "Road to Riyadh" program to promote awareness of the Kingdom's role in data and statistics and support knowledge exchange and international collaboration. 

The initiative featured a series of in-person and virtual sessions, seminars, and workshops held across several cities in the Kingdom throughout the year.

The program reflects GASTAT's ongoing efforts to strengthen the Kingdom's position in the statistical field and support the development of data and statistical systems in line with the Sustainable Development Goals and Saudi Vision 2030.

The Second Saudi Statistics Forum is a key "Road to Riyadh" event.

title: Tuwaiq: A Journey Through Museums
description:
The Museums Commission, in cooperation with the Tuwaiq Exhibitions and Conferences Association, presents “Tuwaiq: A Journey Through Museums,” a temporary cultural exhibition at Al-Masmak Palace Museum in Riyadh, taking place from 27 October to 9 November 2026. The exhibition offers visitors an opportunity to explore Saudi Arabia’s rich cultural and historical heritage through an engaging experience that connects communities with the Kingdom’s past.

Exhibition Highlights:

 Saudi Heritage: Discover aspects of the Kingdom’s rich history and cultural identity.
 Cultural Programmes: Explore activities designed to connect visitors with Saudi Arabia’s historical heritage.
 Historical Landmark: Experience the exhibition within the historic setting of Al-Masmak Palace Museum.
 Heritage Preservation: Learn about the importance of preserving and promoting the Kingdom’s cultural landmarks.

Know More

title: Quarter Tone Exhibition
description:
The Ministry of Culture is presenting the Quarter Tone exhibition at Fenaa Alawwal Center in Riyadh, offering a sensory exploration of the relationship between music and visual art. Conceived by artist Naseer Shamma, the exhibition transforms sawdust and wood remnants from oud-making into visual artworks inspired by sound, maqam, and rhythm. An accompanying cultural program will feature discussions with artists and researchers exploring connections between sound, place, memory, and identity.

description: CONTINUUM 26 at Diriyah Art Futures showcases new works by participants in the second Emerging New Media Artists Program. title: Saudi Build
description:
Saudi Build 2026 (36th Edition) takes place in Riyadh on 2–5 November 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, continuing more than 36 years as a leading meeting point for the Kingdom’s building and infrastructure sectors. The exhibition offers structured opportunities to connect with key decision-makers—bringing together distributors, trade buyers, project owners, consultants, architectural engineers, and specifiers to source products and explore innovative solutions from industry professionals and suppliers. Key showcase areas include interior design and finishing, construction and building materials, Stone Tech, PMV (plants, heavy machinery and vehicles), wood and production technologies, construction technologies and services, special construction services, and aluminium, doors, facades, glass and windows.

title: Darah Event
description:
Under the patronage and in the presence of HRH Princess Haifa Bint Faisal Bin Abdulaziz, Chairwoman of Zahra Breast Cancer Association, the second edition of Darah Event takes place from 29 October to 2 November 2026 at the Cultural Palace in Riyadh’s Diplomatic Quarter. The event celebrates heritage, culture, and fashion, bringing together tradition, creativity, and contemporary elegance while highlighting cultural authenticity and refined design in the heart of the Saudi capital.

Know More

About Darah Event
Darah is more than a retail exhibition; it is a platform dedicated to supporting designers, emerging talents, and artisans, bringing them together under one roof in an experience that connects the past, present, and future. The event celebrates local creativity, showcases Saudi craftsmanship, and provides a space for talents to gain recognition while reflecting the richness of the Kingdom’s cultural heritage.

The name “Darah” draws inspiration from King Abdulaziz’s darah, or reception majlis, at Al-Murabba Palace, where the Kingdom’s founder welcomed his guests. Its visual identity is inspired by the lavender flower, a symbol closely associated with Saudi Arabia’s landscape, reflecting the event’s connection to the Kingdom’s heritage, hospitality, and cultural identity.
